rules.null: every name slot replaced by a random name of the same length and same 0.5-decade log10-weight bin (widened to >= 10 names) from first_<sex>.tsv, surnames.tsv or nick_<sex>.tsv; constants and one-letter initials kept; same renderings rebuilt
rules.statistics: persons = number of persons with >= 1 fitting rendering (0-2 fillers); persons0 = same with 0 fillers; renderings = number of fitting renderings
